:rotating_light: _new alert — needs human_
Channel: alert-frontend-errors  -  confidence: 0.55  -  bug-type guess: env

*Symptoms:*
• Alert fired at 22:39:12 EDT (2026-05-03T02:39:12Z) via Monitor 77419271 "Unusual number of XHR errors for account"
• Alert text not available (content in Slack attachment, not surfaced by tooling)
• Most likely account: *exloc9* — burst of 20+ status=0 network errors to 3rd-party analytics endpoints (`/collect`, `/ccm/collect`) at 02:37–02:38Z
• Secondary finding: `/gateway/syncutil/syncwidget/*/GetSyncWidgetInfoAsync` has been failing status=0 across 4+ accounts since ~02:38Z (see alert 2 for full detail)
*Trace IDs:* none available (frontend RUM only, no APM traces)

*Likely cause:* Two overlapping signals — (a) exloc9 users have analytics endpoints blocked (corporate firewall / ad-blocker policy), which may have triggered this alert, OR (b) this alert is also catching the onset of the syncutil service outage. Cannot confirm without seeing the Slack attachment content.

*Suggested next action:* Check the alert attachment in #alert-frontend-errors to confirm the account name. If exloc9 analytics, add to `kb/false-alarms.json` with `silence_for: "24h"`. If syncutil-related, see alert 2 below for details.

:rotating_light: _new alert — needs human_
Channel: alert-frontend-errors  -  confidence: 0.72  -  bug-type guess: env (service down)

*Symptoms:*
• Alert fired at 22:44:16 EDT (2026-05-03T02:44:16Z) via Monitor 77419271 "Unusual number of XHR errors for account"
• `GET /gateway/syncutil/syncwidget/{account}/GetSyncWidgetInfoAsync` returning *status=0 (Failed to load / network error)* across multiple accounts
• Failure started: *~02:38Z* | Still failing as of: *03:14Z* (~36 min and ongoing)
• Accounts confirmed affected: `criterioncriticalsystems` (10+ errors), `jimslandscapeandlawncarellc` (6+), `biggameusaCo2` (2+), `atWork` (1+)
• Users from distinct geographic locations (Ontario CA, Illinois US, Texas US) — not a single user's network issue
*Trace IDs:* none (frontend RUM only; syncutil service has no Datadog APM telemetry)

*Gateway route:*
Upstream: `/gateway/syncutil/syncwidget/{account}/GetSyncWidgetInfoAsync`
Downstream: `microservices.methodlocal.int:80/syncutil/syncwidget/GetSyncWidgetInfoAsync`
(per `ms-gateway-api/gateway/API/ocelot.syncutil.json`)

*Status=0 means no HTTP response* — the TCP connection is being dropped or the backend is not accepting requests.

*Likely cause:* The `ms-sync-util` application on `microservices.methodlocal.int` IIS is down or its application pool has stopped. No Datadog service-level telemetry for `syncutil` is present (no logs, no metric hits), consistent with the service being offline. Recent deploys in adjacent repos: `legacy-syncservice-api` fix commit 2026-04-30, `ms-gateway-api` revert 2026-04-30 (not related to syncutil routes).

*Suggested next actions:*
1. Check IIS on the `microservices.methodlocal.int` server — look for the `syncutil` virtual app / app pool status
2. If pool is stopped, restart it and confirm `GetSyncWidgetInfoAsync` responds
3. Check Windows Event Log on that server for crash/startup failure around 02:38Z
4. If a deploy caused this, roll back `legacy-syncservice-api` commit `630bf54` (2026-04-30)

:rotating_light: _new alert — needs human_
Channel: alert-frontend-errors  -  confidence: 0.45  -  bug-type guess: env

*Time window:* 2026-05-03 08:10–08:30 UTC
*Trigger:* Monitor 77419271 "Unusual number of XHR errors for account" (>40 XHR errors in 5 min, per account)

*Symptoms:*
• Account `alocetsystem` had 40+ XHR errors (`status_code: 0` / "Failed to load") on `GET https://api.method.me/apps/manage/alocetsystem/LegacyPermissions?keepMethodSupport=true`
• All errors are network-level (`status_code: 0`), not application errors (no 5xx)
• Errors started ~08:10 UTC, fully resolved by 08:30 UTC (~20 min window)
• No concurrent application-layer errors from the same endpoint in Datadog APM
*Comparison vs 24h baseline:* Baseline 20 errors in 20-min window (generic frontend noise). `alocetsystem/LegacyPermissions` pattern is NEW today — not present in yesterday's 08:10–08:30 window.

*Recent deploys:* No UI deploy since 2026-04-24. No backend deploy correlation found.

*Representative request IDs:* `26275013-3185-4734-99b0-769664337f06` (deccanfoods4 — background noise); alocetsystem requests have no request-id (status 0 = never reached server)

*Likely cause:* Transient connectivity between browser clients and `api.method.me/apps/manage` (runtime-core Apps.Api). Could be a brief IIS app pool recycle or network blip. The fact that `status_code: 0` means requests never reached the server — either the connection was refused or reset. Since `alocetsystem` is the Method admin account, this could also be an automated process polling the endpoint.

*Suggested next action:* Monitor for recurrence over next hour. If it recurs: check runtime-core IIS pool health and review `DeveloperTools/method-infrastructure/01-iis-inventory.md`. If one-off, consider adding to `kb/false-alarms.json` with `silence_for: "1h"`.

:rotating_light: _new alert — needs human_
Channel: alert-frontend-errors  -  confidence: 0.50  -  bug-type guess: env (single account)

*Time window:* 2026-05-03 08:17–now (ongoing as of 09:11 UTC)
*Trigger:* Monitor 77419271 "Unusual number of XHR errors for account" fired at 08:22:11 UTC

*Symptoms:*
• `crslaboratories` account has persistent `XHR error GET .../gateway/syncutil/syncwidget/crslaboratories/GetSyncWidgetInfoAsync?viewNameFriendly=<view>` — all `status_code: 0` (Failed to load)
• *Still occurring* as of 09:11 UTC (18+ errors since 08:00, at Datadog API limit — actual count likely higher)
• Errors span multiple views: `PurchaseOrder`, `ItemInventory` — not view-specific
• Also in the trigger window: `savannahsurfaces2` had 2x `XHR error GET properties://browser/` (browser extension noise, not a real error)
*Comparison vs 24h baseline:* Yesterday 08:10–08:30 had 1 crslaboratories syncwidget error. Today has 18+ since 08:00 — ~18x elevated. Pattern is new.

*Recent deploys:* No UI deploy since 2026-04-24. No known sync-util deployment found.

*Trace IDs:* No request IDs available (status_code 0 = request never reached server)

*Likely cause:* `crslaboratories` is unable to reach the sync widget backend (`/gateway/syncutil/syncwidget/`). Since all errors are status_code 0 (connection-level failure, not HTTP error), the request never reaches `ms-sync-util` or `legacy-syncservice-api`. Possible causes:
1. The `syncutil` virtual app within the IIS `microservices` pool is unhealthy for this account
2. A per-account configuration issue blocking the request at the gateway
3. Network-level routing issue for `crslaboratories.method.me`
*Suggested next action:* Check IIS health for the `syncutil` virtual app (`DeveloperTools/method-infrastructure/01-iis-inventory.md`). If the pool is healthy, test `GetSyncWidgetInfoAsync` directly for `crslaboratories` account to confirm it's reproducible. This may need a check of legacy-syncservice-api or ms-sync-util logs.

:rotating_light: _new alert — needs human_
Channel: alert-system  -  confidence: 0.60  -  bug-type guess: env (observability gap)

*Time window:* 2026-05-03 ~05:00–09:15+ UTC (ongoing)
*Trigger:* Monitor 236570583 "New issue to review" (Watchdog APM/infra story) fired at 08:55:34 UTC

*Symptoms:*
• *Entire backend APM trace stream has gone dark* since approximately 00:13 UTC
• `runtime-core-api`, `designer-core-api`, `ms-gateway-api`, `ms-tables-fields-api` — ALL show "No Data" for APM hits and error metrics
• Only `ms-account-api` returns APM data (avg 40 hits/measurement point in 08:50–09:10 UTC)
• *No backend Serilog/NLog logs* in Datadog from 08:45–09:00 UTC — only browser-side `method-ui` RUM logs visible
• Watchdog detected the throughput collapse and filed a story at 08:55 UTC
*Related monitors that fired today:*
• `[17420774]` runtime-core-api high error rate → fired 00:13 UTC, now No Data
• `[17872725]` runtime-core-api high p90 latency → fired 00:13 UTC, now No Data
• `[117424880]` runtime-core-api throughput anomaly → fired 05:46 UTC, now No Data
• `[115452625]` designer-core-api throughput anomaly → fired 05:27 UTC, now No Data
• `[115452626]` designer-core-api high latency → now No Data (last triggered 2026-05-02T23:54Z)
*Is the stack actually down?* Partially. Browser RUM shows real users actively using the platform (crslaboratories, deccanfoods4, alocetsystem sessions active). Some XHR errors exist (see separate alerts) but login and navigation appear functional.

*Comparison vs 24h baseline:* `runtime-core-api` APM also showed "No Data" at this same 05:00–09:15 UTC window 24h ago — suggests the metric tag may have always been wrong, OR the observation gap predates today.

*Recent deploys:*
• `runtime-core`: `b1f9358` 2026-05-01 "Revert currency symbols" (revert of #2615)
• `runtime-core`: `898e5d4` 2026-04-30 "Add caching to LegacyPermissions" — _this directly relates to today's alocetsystem `/LegacyPermissions` XHR failures_
• `method-platform-ui`: No deploy since 2026-04-24
*Likely cause (two hypotheses):*
1. *Datadog APM agent/forwarder is broken* on backend servers (most likely — `ms-account-api` still reports because it's on a different host). The services themselves may be healthy but not observed.
2. *runtime-core services had genuine issues at midnight* (monitors fired at 00:13 UTC) that may have caused a silent crash or IIS pool recycle, after which the APM agent stopped.
*Suggested next actions:*
1. SSH into the backend server and run `datadog-agent status` — check if agent is running and forwarding traces
2. Check IIS application pool state for `runtime-core` pool
3. Verify `GET https://api.method.me/apps/manage/alocetsystem/LegacyPermissions` returns a valid HTTP status (not connection refused) — this would confirm whether the Apps.Api (5200) is actually responding
4. Review `898e5d4` ("Add caching to LegacyPermissions") — the caching change may have introduced a Redis-dependency issue that caused the midnight error spike

:rotating_light: _new alert — needs human_
Channel: `alert-frontend-errors`  -  confidence: 0.55  -  bug-type guess: `data`

*Triggered by:* DD Monitor 77419271 — _"Unusual number of XHR errors for account"_ (fired `2026-05-03T10:36:11Z`)

*Symptoms:*
• `TypeError: null is not an object (evaluating 't.data.ribbons')` × 5 — in `refreshappribbons()` callback on `platform.min.js`
• `Failed to load` (XHR resource error) × 5 — preceding each TypeError in ~17-sec polling loop
• Both error types concentrated in *one session* (`828899fb-ccea-4734-b79a-f1d58a6011ae`), account age 1172 days
• 10 noise-only `ResizeObserver loop` errors (excluded from monitor count, not actionable)
*Trace IDs / Session:* `session_id: 828899fb-ccea-4734-b79a-f1d58a6011ae`

*Baseline comparison (same window 24h ago):*
• `TypeError null ribbons`: 0 occurrences yesterday → *new today*
• `Failed to load`: 8 yesterday vs 5 today (similar baseline level)
*Recent deploys:* Last deploy was `2026-05-01T18:55Z` — Revert of currency-symbols feature (#5735), 44h before alert. Timing doesn't tightly correlate.

*Likely cause:* The `refreshappribbons()` function in legacy MethodUI polls a backend endpoint every ~17s. That endpoint is returning null (or failing with a network/XHR error) for this specific account's session. After the failed load, `t.data.ribbons` is null → TypeError. Issue is isolated to one session/account; no cross-account blast radius visible.

*Suggested next action:* Identify which endpoint `refreshappribbons` calls (look for the XHR target in the un-minified source or browser DevTools for this account). Check if that endpoint (likely in runtime-core or ms-gateway) is returning null data for this account's ribbon config. Look at whether this account has unusual ribbon/app configuration.

:rotating_light: _new alert — needs human_
Channel: `alert-runtime-monitoring`  -  confidence: 0.45  -  bug-type guess: `env` (APM agent / service health)

*Alert time:* `2026-05-03T10:34:55Z`

*Note:* Bot message content was empty (could not retrieve alert text from Slack MCP). Investigation based on DD monitors, metrics, and logs.

*Symptoms:*
• `runtime-core-api` APM: *No Data* in Datadog for the entire last 4+ hours — zero trace points returned
• 6 runtime monitors currently in "No Data" state, including high error rate, high p90 latency, RTC Screen Load, RTC Action Execution, and throughput anomaly
• Throughput anomaly monitors fired at *05:27 UTC* (designer-core-api) and *05:46 UTC* (runtime-core-api) — both now in No Data
• Zero backend service errors visible in DD logs; only `method-ui` frontend errors present
*Trace IDs:* None available — APM not sending data

*Timeline correlation:*
• `2026-05-03T00:09-00:14Z` — runtime-core monitors (error rate, latency, screen load, action exec) all triggered
• `2026-05-03T05:27Z` — designer-core-api throughput anomaly
• `2026-05-03T05:46Z` — runtime-core-api throughput anomaly
• `2026-05-03T10:31-10:36Z` — frontend XHR ribbon failures (hashes `c2f6f320885a1eb8`, `87ee38f2e7c03263`) — *may be downstream of this issue*
*Recent deploys:*
• `2026-05-01T18:50Z` — `runtime-core` Revert of currency-symbols feature (#2657)
• `2026-04-30T19:13Z` — `runtime-core` Improved CPU usage and caching (#2611)
• `2026-04-30T19:12Z` — `runtime-core` Add caching to LegacyPermissions (#2610)
*Likely cause:* Runtime-core-api APM telemetry stopped flowing around midnight UTC. Either the Datadog APM agent is down/misconfigured, or the service itself has degraded (possibly IIS pool issue). The caching changes to `LegacyPermissions` (Apr 30) are worth investigating — if ribbons use legacy permission checks and caching broke those, it would explain the XHR ribbon failures.

*Suggested next actions:*
1. Check `/health/check` on runtime-core-api (Port 5000)
2. Check IIS app pool status for `runtime-core` pool on prod server
3. Verify Datadog APM agent is running and tagging traces with `env:prod`
4. Review `Add caching to LegacyPermissions` (#2610) — if ribbons use `LegacyPermissions`, a broken cache could return null data
5. Check ES/Serilog logs for runtime-core errors (ES MCP returned 403 in this run — manual check needed)
